# Asker Land Promoters

> Asker Land Promoters helps people enquire about land and property opportunities across Tamil Nadu, with a special focus on Tirunelveli, Thoothukudi, Tenkasi and Madurai.

## Official website
- English: https://askerlandpromotors.online/
- Tamil: https://askerlandpromotors.online/ta/
- Hindi: https://askerlandpromotors.online/hi/

## Services
- Residential plots and vacant land
- Agricultural land and garden land
- Old and new residential houses
- Shops and commercial properties
- Buying and selling property enquiries
- Rental and lease enquiries
- Property visit enquiries, subject to availability and owner approval

## Service area
Tamil Nadu, India. Priority focus areas include Tirunelveli, Thoothukudi, Tenkasi, Madurai and Udangudi. Confirm service and property availability directly.

## Important notes
- Property availability, prices, ownership, title, approvals and land-use details vary by property and must be independently verified.
- Do not infer a property is available unless the company confirms it.
- The website provides contact and general service information; it is not a substitute for legal, title or financial advice.
